Michelin Guide Khon Kaen 2026
Real Isan on a Bib budget
intro: Khon Kaen is where you eat Isan food seriously and cheaply, all day long. The 2026 Michelin list hands out 11 Bib Gourmands here, from the fiery larb at Praprai and Prasit to the charcoal-kissed grilled pork neck at Khon Kaen Grilled Pork Neck and the beef noodles at Here Joi that draw a morning queue.
quickAnswerHtml: Khon Kaen has 11 Michelin 2026 restaurants, all Bib Gourmand, leaning heavily into Isan cooking and wallet-friendly street food.

faq.q: How many Michelin restaurants does Khon Kaen have?
faq.a: In 2026 Khon Kaen holds 11 Michelin restaurants, all of them Bib Gourmand, with no starred spots yet. The strength here is genuine Isan food and street eats at gentle prices.

faq.q: Where should I go for real Isan larb?
faq.a: Take your pick of Praprai, Prasit, So Jeng and Mekin Farm. All four are Isan kitchens the guide vouches for, and all cook with the bold, punchy flavours the region is known for.

faq.q: What is the cheapest Bib Gourmand in Khon Kaen?
faq.a: Sriruen Pad Thai at 45 baht a plate and Khon Kaen Grilled Pork Neck from 50 to 60 baht are the best-value picks on the list. Both fill you up without a second thought.

faq.q: Where should a first-timer start eating in Khon Kaen?
faq.a: Start with beef noodles at Here Joi in the morning, move on to larb at Praprai, and close the day with grilled pork neck. Noodles, larb and grill all in one day.

faq.q: Is the Khon Kaen Michelin list good for street-food lovers?
faq.a: Very much so. You get Jok Guay Jab Tom Sen Bat Queue, Leng Yentafo and Khun Jaeng pak mor noodles, most under 100 baht a head and easy to just sit down and enjoy.
